title: Short‐term repeatability of standard and maximum metabolic rates in yellow perch (Perca flavescens)
content:
Abstract

Metabolic rate is often assumed to be a trait that remains relatively consistent within individuals, with most variation attributed to environmental factors. However, few studies have quantified metabolic repeatability in fishes. We examined the short-term repeatability of standard metabolic rate (SMR), absolute aerobic scope (AAS) and maximum metabolic rate (MMR) in yellow perch (Perca flavescens; n = 15). Repeatability was moderate for SMR (R = 0.318), mild for AAS (R = 0.243) and poor for MMR (R = 0.080), indicating modest within-individual variability in metabolic measurements over a 32-day experiment. More data on metabolic repeatability across varying contexts are needed to help understand within- and among-individual variation.
